referenceGuides.title: Flange Design - FAST - R09
usePolicy: Use as a guide for finding workbook concepts, symbol names, unit conversions, and future comparison scenarios.
Do not execute workbook macros during automated intake.
Do not copy workbook formulas into the calculation core unless each formula is traced back to an approved source standard, edition, clause or formula reference, and validation evidence.
Do not qualify calculations from workbook agreement alone.
